title: Saying no: nem before the verb

sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: To say that you do not do something, put *nem* right before the verb: *Nem főzök.* The verb keeps its ending. A place or time word stays where it was: *A konyhában nem főzök.*

items.english: I do not cook at home.
I do not walk in the park.

sections.content: *Nem* goes with action verbs. *Nincs* means “there is no” or “is not (here)”: *Anna nincs itt*, but *Anna nem ír*. Never say *Anna nincs ír*.
